QuestInfo.name: Sand Bandits' Third Mission
QuestInfo.0: The Sand Bandits serve the residents of #m260000000#. Now that you're a member of the Sand Bandits, you ought to receive a mission. Go see #b#p2101010##k.
QuestInfo.1: You need to defeat the monsters threatening the safety of the residents of Ariant.
QuestInfo.2: You reduced the number of #o2110301# monsters. It will be safer for the residents of Ariant to cross Sahel.

0.0: There's a new Sand Bandit mission. The queen is mobilizing the people of Ariant to gather scorpion stingers, which is putting them in danger.
0.1: Protect the people and buy some time by defeating #o2110301#. Then, we will send the swapped-out stingers to the queen. Their effect will not be what she wanted, and then maybe she will not want to gather stingers anymore. I leave this mission to you. You can do it, right?

yes.0: Defeat around #b100 #o2110301# enemies#k. We'll take care of the rest...

no.0: You are not ready to take on this mission yet...

1.0: Looks like you safely completed the mission.

yes.0: Good work. The queen won't be calling on the people to do anything dangerous for a while. I'll send word to you when the Sand Bandits have something else for you to do.
